units: <cite ref="Shabbat 148a:1">Sabb. 148ᵃ</cite> <he>זיל גַּרְבֵיה</he> go and seize him (take his coat until he appears).

<cite ref="Shabbat 148a:1">Ib.</cite> <he>לא בדינא גְרַבְתִּיךְ</he> was I not right in summoning thee? <cite ref="Chagigah 5b:1">Ḥag. 5ᵇ</cite> <he>גַּרְבוּהוּ</he> they (the royal officers) seized his property.
<cite ref="Gittin 45a:14">Gitt. 45ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דלא לִיגַרְבוּ וכ׳</he> in order that robbers should not be tempted to kidnap persons and then offer them for ransom.

senses.gloss: to be robbed. Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᵈ אִיגַּרְבַת thou hast been robbed of one Denar.
